message: Persian or Urdu letter in an Arabic value: write ي (U+064A) and ك (U+0643); گ پ چ ژ are not Modern Standard Arabic letters (STYLE 21.4).
ASCII comma, semicolon or question mark after Arabic text or a placeholder: write ، (U+060C), ؛ (U+061B) or ؟ (U+061F) (Microsoft Arabic style guide 4.1.14, STYLE 21.3).
ASCII comma after a Latin word or number inside an Arabic sentence: write ، (U+060C); digit grouping (1,234) keeps its comma (STYLE 21.3).
Arabic-Indic or Persian digit or separator: write 0-9 with the English decimal point and grouping (1,234,567.5) (PD-OI-106, campaign D-15; Microsoft 4.1.12).
Space before ، ؛ ؟ : . or !: attach the mark to the word before it (Microsoft 4.1.14).
Curly quotes or guillemets: write straight double quotes "…" around a cited name or control (Microsoft Arabic style guide 4.1.14, STYLE 21.3).
Space inside straight quotes: write "{name}" with no space after the opening or before the closing quote (STYLE 21.3).

Diacritic outside the allowed cases: Arabic UI text is unvocalized except tanween on a final alef (اً), جارٍ, damma on a passive prefix (يُرجى) and a shadda that separates homographs (ممكّن) (Microsoft 4.1.7, STYLE 21.4).
Tanween fath before the alef: write it on the final alef (سجلاً, تلقائياً) as the Microsoft Arabic style guide 4.1.7 does (STYLE 21.4).
Tatweel (kashida) U+0640: delete it; never stretch a word or write الـ before a Latin term (STYLE 21.4).
Right arrow → inside an Arabic sentence points against the reading order: write ← (U+2190) or words (ثم, إلى); → stays only as a picture of a physical direction (يمين →) (STYLE 21.3).
A range written with a dash or hyphen between two numbers or placeholders reads end–start in a right-to-left line: write من {start} إلى {end} (STYLE 21.3).
A hyphen between spaces is not a dash: rewrite with ، or : or parentheses (STYLE 21.3).
Arabic letter glued to a placeholder (ال{file}, ب{name}, {file}ه): put a class noun next to it (الملف {file}, بالسجل {record}) and write و with a space (و {name}) (STYLE 21.5).
The article ال glued to a Latin term, number or quote: put a class noun with the article first (ملف GenBank, تنسيق TSV, أداة LOSAT) (Microsoft 4.1.4, 4.1.8; STYLE 21.4).
Latin letter glued to an Arabic letter (بBLAST, وGenBank): put a space between them, or a class noun (بأداة BLAST) (STYLE 21.4).

Imperative or second-person verb (masculine or feminine): write a verbal noun, or يمكنك / يُرجى / يجب + verbal noun (النقر على "إنشاء المخطط", يُرجى اختيار ملف) (Microsoft Arabic style guide 3.1, STYLE 21.2).
Wrong sense: legend is وسيلة الإيضاح (أسطورة is a myth), a tick is علامة التجزئة (قراد is the animal), default is افتراضي (تقصير means negligence) (STYLE 21.1).

Not the glossary word: a feature is عنصر (not ميزة), gene جين (not مورثة), genome جينوم (not مجين or مجموع مورثي), strand سلسلة (not جديلة or خيط), browser المتصفح, session جلسة (not دورة) (STYLE 21.1).

Hamza missing on the alef (اضافة, اعادة, الغاء, اظهار, انشاء, اقصى): write إضافة, إعادة, إلغاء, إظهار, إنشاء, أقصى; hamzat wasl words (استخدام, اختيار, استيراد) stay bare (Microsoft 4.1.9, STYLE 21.4).
Final ى / ي confused: write في, إلى, على (Modern Standard Arabic spelling as Microsoft and Google write it) (STYLE 21.4).
Decomposed hamza or madda (alef + U+0653/U+0654/U+0655): store the composed letter أ إ آ ؤ ئ (NFC) (STYLE 21.4).
Three periods or a doubled ellipsis: write one … (U+2026) attached to the last word (STYLE 1.2).
Leading, trailing or doubled space, or an invisible character (NBSP, ZWSP, WJ, BOM): use single ordinary spaces; units keep the source spacing (100 bp) (STYLE 1.2).
Space inside parentheses, or between a number and %: write (اختياري) and 50% (Microsoft 4.1.14, 4.1.15; STYLE 21.3).
Mode adjective after خريطة: the mode attaches to the diagram, so write خريطة المخطط الخطي / الدائري, not خريطة خطية / دائرية (Linear map / Circular map row of the glossary).
